blocks.text: A terrible accident changed my life. A friend and I were driving home from a midnight movie. As we approached an intersection, we stopped at a red light. No cars seemed to be coming, so I decided to go through the red light. Immediately after we started, I lost consciousness. Later I learned that we had hit a car coming from the other direction. That accident made my friend spend the rest of his life in a wheelchair, and I learned a costly lesson.
